result:
Summary: The HotpotQA original paper reports that in the full wiki setting, the test Hits@10 score is 55.88. This score is part of the retrieval performance metrics shown in Table 5, which also includes Mean Average Precision (MAP), Mean Rank, and Hits@2. The full wiki setting tests the model's ability at multi-hop reasoning in the wild by requiring it to answer questions given the first paragraphs of all Wikipedia articles without specified gold paragraphs.
